title: Indroda Nature Park Gandhinagar - India’s Jurassic Park & Wildlife Experience
content:
Indroda Nature Park, Gandhinagar - The Jurassic Park of India

Located on the banks of the Sabarmati River in Gandhinagar, Indroda Nature Park is one of India’s most unique and educational wildlife parks. Managed by the Gujarat Ecological Education and Research Foundation (GEER), it is often called “India’s Jurassic Park” because of its rare dinosaur fossil exhibits. The park combines fun, learning, and nature, making it an ideal destination for families, students, and nature lovers.

Spread across vast green landscapes, the park is divided into several sections - a dinosaur and fossil park, a botanical garden, a zoo, an aviary, and a marine section. Visitors can explore life-sized dinosaur replicas, understand prehistoric life, and enjoy spotting animals like deer, peacocks, crocodiles, and turtles. The serene environment and educational value make it a perfect spot for a day outing.

Things to See and Do

  • Explore the Dinosaur and Fossil Section with replicas and real fossils.
  • Visit the Botanical Garden featuring a wide variety of plants.
  • Spend time at the Zoo observing native and exotic species.
  • Learn about marine life at the Aquatic Gallery.
  • Relax and enjoy nature trails, perfect for photography and picnics.

How to Reach

  • By Air: The nearest airport is Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel International Airport, Ahmedabad (25 km).
  • By Train: Gandhinagar Railway Station is about 2 km from the park.
  • By Road: Easily accessible via Gandhinagar-Ahmedabad highway; local taxis and buses are available.

Visiting Time and Entry Fee

  • Timings: 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM (Closed on Mondays)
  • Entry Fee: ₹20 for adults, ₹10 for children (additional charges for camera use)

Nearby Places to Visit

  • Akshardham Temple - Magnificent spiritual complex (4 km)
  • Dandi Kutir Museum - Gandhi’s life and freedom struggle (3 km)
  • Sarita Udyan - Peaceful garden beside the Sabarmati River (5 km)
  • Adalaj Stepwell - Stunning 15th-century architectural wonder (8 km)
  • Children’s Park - Amusement rides and toy train for kids (2 km)
excerpt: Indroda Nature Park in Gandhinagar offers a fascinating blend of nature, wildlife, and prehistoric exhibits. Known as India’s Jurassic Park, it’s a must-visit for families and students. The park’s greenery and educational displays make it both relaxing and enriching.
